jobs.displayName: Build, package, and publish Windows release
jobs.bootstrapProof: The push/workflow_dispatch job starts on a fresh GitHub-hosted Windows image, runs build.bat /s and build-installer.bat /s, and fails before publication if either bootstrap or packaging path cannot supply a declared dependency.

dependencies.name: Git
dependencies.constraint: Git CLI available to the checked-out repository
dependencies.bootstrap: actions/checkout validates the Git checkout before the build scripts run

dependencies.name: GitHub CLI
dependencies.constraint: gh CLI compatible with GitHub Releases and Actions REST APIs
dependencies.bootstrap: The workflow checks gh --version before release preparation

dependencies.name: PowerShell
dependencies.constraint: PowerShell 7 for workflow scripts and Windows PowerShell 5.1-compatible helpers where called by batch files
dependencies.bootstrap: The workflow uses pwsh and the batch scripts invoke powershell.exe explicitly

dependencies.name: Microsoft Build Tools
dependencies.constraint: Visual Studio 2022 MSBuild with the .NET Framework desktop build workload
dependencies.source: Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools from the canonical winget source when absent
dependencies.bootstrap: build.bat discovers MSBuild with vswhere and installs the exact canonical winget package non-interactively when missing

dependencies.name: .NET Framework reference assemblies
dependencies.source: NuGet.org v3 flat-container package with SHA-512 verified against NuGet registration metadata
dependencies.bootstrap: build.bat installs the pinned package into a per-user toolchain cache when the developer targeting pack is absent

dependencies.name: NuGet project packages
dependencies.constraint: Versions declared by the solution packages.config files and project files
dependencies.source: NuGet sources declared by the repository and MSBuild restore
dependencies.bootstrap: build.bat runs solution-context MSBuild Restore with RestorePackagesConfig=true

dependencies.name: Node.js
dependencies.source: nodejs.org official Windows x64 archive with SHA-256 verified against SHASUMS256.txt
dependencies.bootstrap: scripts/ensure-node.ps1 reuses an exact installed version or installs the verified archive into a per-user toolchain cache

dependencies.name: Exchange Auto Installer npm packages
dependencies.constraint: Exact package-lock.json lockfile, including Electron 43.4.0 and electron-builder 26.15.3
dependencies.bootstrap: build.bat and build-installer.bat run npm ci from the owning package

dependencies.name: Inno Setup
dependencies.source: JRSoftware.InnoSetup from the canonical winget source
dependencies.bootstrap: build-installer.bat discovers ISCC.exe and installs the canonical package non-interactively when missing

dependencies.name: Squirrel.Windows packager
dependencies.bootstrap: npm ci materializes the exact locked packager before npm run package

safeOutputs: tracked multi-resolution application and installer icons
